Class Habitat

  • java.lang.Object
    • model.Habitat

  • public class Habitat
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents a Habitat in the zoo with a name, environment type, and area. A habitat can contain up to 10 animals.

      • getAnimalList

        public java.lang.String getAnimalList()
        Retrieves a list of animals in the habitat. This method iterates through the array of animals (`myAnimals`) and concatenates the names of non-null animals into a single string, separated by newlines.
        Returns:
        A string containing the names of all animals in the habitat, each on a new line.

      • hasAnimal

        public boolean hasAnimal(java.lang.String animalName)
        Checks if the habitat contains an animal with the specified name.
        Parameters:
        animalName - The name of the animal to search for.
        Returns:
        true if the animal is found in the habitat, false otherwise.

      • getAnimalMonthlyFoodCost

        public double getAnimalMonthlyFoodCost(java.lang.String animalName)
        Retrieves the monthly food cost for a specific animal in the habitat.
        Parameters:
        animalName - The name of the animal whose monthly food cost is to be calculated.
        Returns:
        The monthly food cost of the specified animal as a double, or 0.0 if the animal is not found.
